project_title: Ahmad's Pixel Loft OS — Interactive Portfolio Design Guidelines
theme: Dark Pixel-Art Vintage OS (Loft Midnight Palette)
instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT redesign the room interiors or portfolio data in portfolio.js / RoomArt.jsx. Preserve house room art and existing layout exactly as specified.
Implement the 5 requested updates cleanly with rigorous pixel-art fidelity and proper data-testid hooks.

1. ROOM SOUNDS: Add subtle Web Audio API synthesized procedural sounds (no external audio files needed; prevents broken asset URLs). Implement a short crisp mechanical click when hovering/focusing or clicking a room (sine/triangle 800Hz->300Hz quick 35ms blip), and a soft wooden door creak/latch thud upon opening/clicking a room (dual-tone frequency modulated filter drop over 160ms with slight resonant friction). Wire this into room button onMouseEnter/onClick.

2. COMPACT MUSIC PLAYER: The current desktop player length is bloated (disc + 160px track bar + full control strip with slider + volume percent = ~420px). Cut its total visible length by ~80% into a tight, handsome rectangular badge (~86px to 96px total width). Display a mini spinning vinyl disc (22px-24px) paired with an icon play/pause button and a discreet popover trigger. When clicked, it pops up the full track details, seekbar, and volume slider. Keep the 10% default volume and retained songs intact.

3. DISMISSIBLE GUIDE POPUP: The guide message speech bubble currently has pointer-events-none and cannot be closed. Give the speech bubble interactive pointer-events, add an explicit retro pixel cross button ('✕' / X) in the top-right corner with data-testid='guide-dismiss-button', allowing the user to dismiss or collapse the bubble. Include a small mini-toggle or clicking the pixel figure to restore the tip.

4. AHMAD'S ROOF BRANDING (ALIGNED IN ROOF DIRECTION): The house roof is an angled trapezoid/triangle created with CSS borders (borderBottom 56px, borderLeft/Right 36px). Ahmad requested 'Ahmad's .... anything and place it on the roof of the house - in the direction of the roof, not plain text'. Place an authentic pixelated angled signplate along the roof pitch: 'AHMAD'S LOFT // AI RESIDENCE'. Position it on the roof shingle plane angled with CSS transform skew/rotate matching the roof pitch (-3.5deg to -4deg or pitched banner along the left slope, or dual pitch 'AHMAD'S' on the left rafter slope (-18deg skewY/rotate) and 'AI LOFT' / 'DEV LAB' on the right rafter slope, or a pitched gable crest banner with pixel rivets and drop shadow).

5. DISTINCTIVE ATMOSPHERIC BACKGROUND: Replace the generic flat gradient with a custom lightweight interactive 2D Canvas pixel nightscape: 'Midnight Islamabad Skyline with Lo-Fi Twinkling Stars, Soft Passing Pixel Clouds & Subtle Ambient Window Lights'. Rendered via requestAnimationFrame on an HTML5 canvas behind the house. Matches Ahmad's Islamabad origin, masculine retro aesthetic, zero glow, clean crisp pixel edges.

contrast_verification.roof_branding: #f3efe6 text on #5c2a22 / #7e352c roof board (ratio 7.8:1, Passes AAA)

features: Pixel grid scaling: Canvas internally rendered at low resolution (e.g. 320x180 or 480x270) with CSS `image-rendering: pixelated` for crisp retro pixels
Layer 1: Deep twilight gradient with pixel dither band transition
Layer 2: 45 twinkling stars with 3 distinct brightness phases
Layer 3: Distant pixelated silhouette of the Margalla Hills / Islamabad mountain ridge with occasional blinking communication tower light
Layer 4: Slow drifting pixel clouds (2 layers with parallax speeds 0.15px and 0.08px per frame)
Zero performance overhead, zero external dependencies

roof_treatment.concept: Pitched Architectural Signboard following the slope of the gable roof
roof_treatment.implementation: Inside House.jsx roof container. Positioned over the left or right slope using CSS transform rotate/skew (-14deg on left pitch or +14deg on right pitch, or a centered angled brass nameplate with 3D pixel bevel: 'AHMAD'S AI LOFT'). Includes embossed brass pixel border (2px solid #3f1d17), background #5c2a22, lettering #f3efe6 with #d9962b punctuation.

sounds.room_hover: Short 25ms high-frequency crisp click (sine wave, 900Hz to 400Hz, volume 0.04)
sounds.door_open: 180ms dual-stage sound: 40ms mechanical latch click (square wave filtered at 600Hz) followed by a 140ms low wooden resonance creak/door swing (triangle wave 180Hz drifting to 90Hz with gentle lowpass filter, volume 0.07)
sounds.guide_close: 30ms soft paper flick (bandpassed white noise burst, volume 0.05)

modifications: Desktop size reduced by 80%: replace the long 420px strip with a compact rectangular module of ~92px x 34px
Visual appearance: A crisp pixel-bordered rectangular pill/box `border-2 border-[#3a3f4f] bg-[#1a1e28] px-2 py-1 flex items-center gap-2`
Left element: Miniature spinning Disc (24px diameter)
Center/Right element: Mini Play/Pause button (22px x 22px) and Song title tooltip / popover trigger icon
Popover details: Clicking the compact rectangle opens the Radix/Shadcn Popover revealing the full track scrubber, song title/artist, skip buttons, and volume slider at 10%
Maintains full data-testid suite: data-testid='music-player', data-testid='music-toggle', data-testid='music-popover-trigger', data-testid='music-volume'
Add dismiss state (e.g., `dismissed` state or `hidden` toggle)
Allow pointer events on the bubble container while keeping the empty canvas click-through
Include a pixel '✕' close button at top-right of the bubble (`data-testid='guide-dismiss-button'`) with hover state `#d95c4a` (vintage red)
When dismissed, show a small unobtrusive pixel icon button on the guide guy ('?' or '💬') allowing the user to unhide/reopen the guide whenever desired (`data-testid='guide-restore-button'`)
Add angled roof typography 'AHMAD'S AI LOFT' or 'AHMAD'S // RESIDENCE' nestled into the roof structure
Use CSS `transform: rotate(-12deg) skewX(-12deg)` on the left roof pitch or centered faceted timber fascia plate

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Retain the established masculine retro-tech aesthetic with hard pixel shadows and zero soft glows.
Ensure the entire loft fits cleanly in desktop viewports (100dvh) while permitting smooth scrolling on small screens.
Ensure contrast meets or exceeds WCAG AAA standards for all text badges and labels.
All interactive elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes for testing verification.
Verify audio player starts at 10% volume and respects browser autoplay interaction policies.
